specs/content/gpks-402/sources/texts/pak-constitution-1973.md: primary text confirms federal structure (Articles 1, 140A, 142, 153, 155, 160), Parliament (50-52, 59, 70, 73, 75), executive (41, 48, 58, 90, 91), judiciary (175, 175A, 184, 185, 189, 199), Armed Forces (6, 39, 245), fundamental rights (7-28, 233), principles of policy (29-40), citizenship (5, 51), and resource revenue (161); verified against official National Assembly text; grounds topic-01, topic-02, topic-03, and fig-U4-1, fig-U4-2, fig-U4-4, fig-U4-5.

specs/content/gpks-402/sources/texts/hussain-kokab-2012-18th.md: confirms abolition of Concurrent List devolving education to provinces, repeal of Article 58(2)(b) presidential dismissal power, establishment of Judicial Commission, and addition of fundamental rights 10A, 19A, and 25A; grounds topic-01.mdx:42, 97, 122 and topic-02.mdx:47.

specs/content/gpks-402/sources/texts/rizvi-2004-civil-military.md: confirms chronology of military rule and civilian governance 1947-1988, causes of intervention (weak political institutions, external insecurity, institutional disparity, military interests), post-1988 pattern, and foreign alignments (1950s pacts, 1979 Soviet Afghan invasion); grounds topic-01.mdx:143-164 and topic-03.mdx:116, 132.

specs/content/gpks-402/sources/texts/taj-2016-civil-military.md: confirms approximately 32 years of direct military domination (1958-1971, 1977-1988, 1999-2008) and the Musharraf period; grounds topic-01.mdx:151, 156 and fig-U4-3.

specs/content/gpks-402/sources/texts/qureshi-2011-indus.md: confirms Indus Basin as largest contiguous irrigation system supporting 90% of food production, low per-capita storage, reservoir sedimentation, and waterlogging/salinity; grounds topic-03.mdx:81-83 and fig-U4-7.

specs/content/gpks-402/sources/texts/otto-2023-floods.md: confirms 2022 floods as worst in Pakistan's history, increased intense monsoon rainfall associated with warming, and vulnerability factors driving disaster damage; grounds topic-03.mdx:79-80.
specs/content/gpks-402/sources/texts/wolf-2017-cpec.md: confirms CPEC as part of Belt and Road Initiative, hailed as economic game changer, and military security role; grounds topic-03.mdx:120, 129.
